name: @pipeworx/mcp-translate

tools.name: translate
tools.description: Translate text between languages using a LibreTranslate instance you supply — pass _apiKey for libretranslate.com or _endpoint for a self-hosted server. For translation with no key of your own, call mymemory_translate instead.

source.description: Source language code (e.g. "en" for English, "es" for Spanish)

target.description: Target language code (e.g. "es" for Spanish, "fr" for French)

tools.name: detect_language
tools.description: Detect the language of a text string. Returns an array of detected languages with confidence scores.

text.description: The text whose language should be detected

tools.name: list_languages
tools.description: List all languages supported by the translation API. Returns language codes and names.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-translate forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the translate pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
